_comment: PM <-> api-football club aliases. Both sides are stored as written; keys are normalised at load (accents folded, club suffixes dropped). Learned entries come from learn_fixture_aliases.py; manual ones carry a 'why' in provenance. An alias resolves to api-football's literal name and is matched by EQUALITY, never by scoring.
